display.purpose: The page statement. One per page, sentence case Caslon, never uppercase or bold.

h1.purpose: Major section statements on the home page.

h2.purpose: Section headings and closing CTA statements.

h3.purpose: Item names, card titles, privacy section headings.

body-lg.purpose: The fog supporting paragraph directly under a display heading.

body.purpose: Running text at 17px/1.7. Fog when supporting, lamp when it is the content.

small.purpose: Footer text, TCPA consent copy, form errors.

label.purpose: The 12px tracked-caps voice: nav, buttons, form labels, captions, the neon sign. The only uppercase in the system.

shadows.name: deep
shadows.purpose: The window-photo treatment. Seats photographs in the dark like lit displays. Photographs only; UI chrome never casts a shadow.

motion.name: lights-up
motion.purpose: Page arrival: the hero block lights up once.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: The hero photograph settles from a slight zoom, once.

motion.name: mask-open
motion.value: clip-path inset(6% 6% 6% 6%) to inset(0), opacity 0.4 to 1, 900ms cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.25, 1), both
motion.purpose: One-time scroll reveal of photographs. Clip lives on an inner wrapper, never the IntersectionObserver target (Chromium computes IO geometry after clip-path).

motion.name: line-rise
motion.value: translateY(18px) + blur(6px) to sharp, 800ms (700ms as rise-go) cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), both
motion.purpose: Text lines rise like eyes adjusting. Hero lines stagger at 350/550/750ms inline delays.

motion.name: neon-on
motion.purpose: The one neon sign flickers on, once per page.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all animations none; opacity 1; clip-path none
motion.purpose: Every moment collapses under prefers-reduced-motion with content fully visible.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The green door. LQ green fill with night text; hover presses to lq-press, active nudges down 1px. The label says what happens.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-lq-green, #6BB22E); color: var(--color-night, #131311); min-height: 48px; padding: 0 28px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-lq-press, #7EC93C); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-lamp, #F4F2EC); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The second door, always paired with a primary. Lamp text and a 60%-alpha lamp border; hover fills night-2 and completes the border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--color-lamp, #F4F2EC); min-height: 48px; padding: 0 28px; border: 1px solid rgb(244 242 236 / 0.6); border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--color-lamp, #F4F2EC); background: var(--color-night-2, #1C1C19); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-lamp, #F4F2EC); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Nav / Filter Tab
components.description: Label-voice link or filter with a 2px bottom border: transparent and fog at rest, lq-green and lamp when active (aria-current or aria-pressed).
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs"><button class="ds-tab ds-tab-active" aria-pressed="true">The floor</button><button class="ds-tab">Financing</button><button class="ds-tab">Visit</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 28px; } .ds-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 2px 0 0; background: none; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: var(--color-fog, #A3A094); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--color-lamp, #F4F2EC); } .ds-tab-active { border-bottom-color: var(--color-lq-green, #6BB22E); color: var(--color-lamp, #F4F2EC); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-lamp, #F4F2EC); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Night-2 fill on a night-3 hairline, lamp text, fog placeholder, green caret, lamp focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; max-width: 320px; } .ds-field-label { color: var(--color-fog, #A3A094); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-input { min-height: 48px; width: 100%; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--color-night-2, #1C1C19); border: 1px solid var(--color-night-3, #2A2A25); border-radius: 4px; color: var(--color-lamp, #F4F2EC); caret-color: var(--color-lq-green, #6BB22E); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-fog, #A3A094); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-lamp, #F4F2EC); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Neon Sign
components.description: The signature device: one per page. Label-voice copy as a lit green tube with glowing border and text-shadow; flickers on once via neon-on.
components.css: .ds-neon-sign { display: inline-block; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-neon, #8ADE4A); border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgb(107 178 46 / 0.35), inset 0 0 10px rgb(107 178 46 / 0.2); color: var(--color-neon, #8ADE4A); text-shadow: 0 0 6px rgb(138 222 74 / 0.55), 0 0 24px rgb(107 178 46 / 0.4); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Window Photo Figure
components.description: How merchandise is shown: a square-cornered photograph seated by the deep shadow, captioned by a baseline row of Caslon item name and fog label.
components.css: .ds-window-figure { margin: 0; max-width: 360px; } .ds-window-photo { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; width: 100%; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-night-3, #2A2A25), var(--color-night-2, #1C1C19)); box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4), 0 24px 64px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5); } .ds-window-caption { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; margin-top: 16px; } .ds-window-name { color: var(--color-lamp, #F4F2EC); font-family: 'Libre Caslon Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.625rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-window-tag { flex-shrink: 0; color: var(--color-fog, #A3A094); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Open Now Status
components.description: The live hours line. Label voice, lq-press when open, fog when closed, reserved at one line height so hydration never shifts layout.
components.css: .ds-open-now { min-height: 1.4em; color: var(--color-lq-press, #7EC93C); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview:
The site is LQ's warehouse after hours: a warm charcoal room where the overhead lamps are still on over the furniture, photographs sit in the dark like lit window displays, and one green neon sign burns per page. It is premium and unhurried where the business itself is high-volume and fast; the calm presentation is the contrast that makes the warehouse prices land. Everything a visitor sees is either the room (night surfaces, lamp light, fog secondary text), the merchandise (real floor photographs), or the sign (LQ green).

This is the third world for this client (direction roll e1b2fdb5), built after two rejected predecessors: a dark brutalist ink build and a bright cream lit-set build. Both are dead. Nothing from them survives here: no cream field, no bold condensed grotesk display, no flat-poster color blocking. The confirmed anti-references also include the white e-commerce grid, glassmorphism, icon feature grids, numbered marker sequences, and testimonial carousels.

The architecture is multi-page: home, /the-floor (a deal-board surface, roll 6e5352b2), /financing, /visit, /privacy, plus a non-indexed /style-guide. All pages share SiteHeader (with aria-current nav) and SiteFooter. Every page ends at one of two doors: join the text list or deal with financing/visiting in person. Nothing is ever purchasable online.
keyCharacteristics: Warm charcoal night field, always lit by radial lamp pools, never flat black
Serif display voice in sentence case over a working grotesk with tracked-caps labels
LQ green appears only as the primary action and the single neon sign per page
Photographs presented as lit window displays: square-cornered, deep soft shadows
Motion is lighting, not decoration: each moment happens once, then the room holds still
Rural-4G light: no animation/UI/icon libraries, real photos only

rules.name: The Night Text Rule
rules.body: Green surfaces always carry night text, never white. White on LQ green fails contrast at 2.6:1; night on LQ green passes at 7.3:1. There are no exceptions on any surface.

rules.name: The One Sign Rule
rules.body: Exactly one neon element per page: neon-box + neon + label, flickering on once via neon-on. It is a lit object from the store's world (an hours sign, a Financing available sign), not a decorative accent. A second neon element on a page is a defect.

rules.name: The Lit Field Rule
rules.body: The night field must never read flat. At least one section per page carries a lamp pool (.pool: radial rgb(244 232 205 / 0.13) fading from the top center; .pool-left: the same light from the upper left), or the section sits against a lit photograph. Decorative gradient washes stay banned; these radials are the room's own overhead lighting and are the only sanctioned gradients besides photo scrims.

rules.name: The Dark Band Rule
rules.body: Hero photographs get a two-layer night scrim (a radial vignette to rgb(19 19 17 / 0.97) at the edges plus a bottom linear ramp to rgb(19 19 17 / 0.93)). The scrim geometry must keep the band behind the mobile headline under roughly 55 mean luminance so lamp text stays legible over any photo. Re-check this whenever the hero photo or scrim stops changes.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: The Caslon display voice is always sentence case, never uppercase, never bold (the face loads at 400 only). Uppercase belongs exclusively to the 12px tracked .label voice.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No eyebrow or kicker labels above headings. The single neon sign is the only element that may sit above a page's H1, and it is a lit object, not a category label. Headings stand on their own.

rules.name: The Window Display Rule
rules.body: Shadows exist to present merchandise, never to elevate UI. Buttons, inputs, panels, and the header cast no shadow; a shadowed card or dropdown is out of world. Deep soft photo shadows are in; hard offset shadows do not exist here.

dos: Do keep the field lit: every page needs its lamp pools or lit photographs; bare stretches of flat #131311 read as a bug, not restraint.
Do put night text (#131311) on every green surface, per The Night Text Rule (7.3:1).
Do give every tap target 48px minimum height and 8px minimum spacing, with the global lamp focus ring intact.

Do use the store's own words and real floor photographs: "Limited Quantities + Unlimited Savings", tag-price language, photos from assets/photos only. No stock, no AI imagery, no fabricated testimonials.
Do write buttons that say what happens, in sentence-case plain speech: "Walk the floor", "Get directions", "Call (662) 841-5959".

Do keep the TCPA consent language verbatim from src/lib/consent.ts wherever an SMS opt-in appears; it is regulated content, not copy. Any change goes through legal review and bumps SMS_CONSENT_VERSION.
Do end every page at one of the two doors: join the text list, or call/visit/finance in person.
Do collapse every animation under prefers-reduced-motion with the content left fully visible.
donts: Don't imply anything can be bought online. No prices on the site (prices live on the tags), no carts, no "shop" or "buy" language. The footer's closing line is doctrine: the store is the store.
Don't set the Caslon display voice in uppercase or bold, and don't add eyebrow/kicker labels above headings.
Don't use more than one neon element per page, or use the neon color (#8ADE4A) anywhere but the sign.
Don't add decorative gradients, glassmorphism or backdrop blur, icon grids, numbered marker sequences, testimonial carousels, or emoji. The lamp pools and photo scrims are the only gradients.
Don't round structural corners or shadow UI chrome; 4px is for controls, the deep shadow is for photographs.

Don't use em dashes or marketing filler (elevate, curated, seamless, transform, unlock, discover), and don't make operational claims the store hasn't verified. Urgency must be factual: limited quantities is true, so say it plainly and never fake scarcity.
Don't treat the sold flags in src/lib/floor.ts as live inventory; they are placeholder demonstration data pending the client's real board.
Don't add runtime dependencies (animation, UI, icon, or state libraries) without asking; rural 4G is the baseline and the budget is LCP under 2.0s, CLS under 0.05, first-load JS under 120KB gzipped.
